snippet.title: Super Mario Bros. Remastered: Setup Guide
snippet.description:
Struggling with getting SMBR to work? In this video we'll cover how to get things set up, he relevance of a ROM you need to obtain on your own, some useful information on resource packs and how to make use of the level sharing related features made available by LSS.

Edited by TheOliveOli
Voiced by Popthatcorn14

Check out the game here (not out yet):
https://github.com/JHDev2006/Super-Mario-Bros.-Remastered-Public/releases

Find resource packs on the gamebanana page:
https://gamebanana.com/games/22798

Get/upload levels here:
https://levelsharesquare.com/SMBR/levels

Join the SMBR1 discord in case you're in need of support:
https://discord.gg/Bac4u2TkHC

#mario #mariomaker2 #fangame
